name: 6AN Stainless Steel Hose / Line (E85 + Race Fuel Safe) - BY THE FOOT
description: ColorFittings Standard Stainless Steel Braided Hose is engineered for high-pressure fuel, oil, coolant, and breather applications in automotive, marine, and racing builds. Featuring a durable synthetic rubber inner core with a tightly woven stainless steel braid, this hose resists abrasion and pressure delivering reliable flow, excellent flexibility, and consistent performance under demanding conditions.\nDesigned for racing, street performance, and marine applications, this hose is compatible with E85, ethanol-based fuels, race fuels, gasoline, diesel, oil, and coolant. The stainless steel braid provides superior abrasion resistance and structural integrity while maintaining the flexibility needed for clean, precise routing.\nThis hose is designed to be used as part of the ColorFittings system. For a proper seal and reliable performance, pair it with our Standard AN Hose Fittings, precision-machined to match this hose. Use Hose Separators to organize multi-line installations and prevent abrasion, and complete assembly with our Hose Assembly Tools to ensure correct alignment, prevent damage, and achieve professional results.
